repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Hand-off with ux-1, recorded at seat 5's request · 2026-11-19T18:32Z
- **「已个性化」 marker.** ux-1's filter and sort cards (#35549/#35550) leave the 「已个性化」 marker untouched. This card gives its 保存 a home in 「选项」: on one of the reader's own views, the menu offers 保存 (the list on screen becomes that view's stored body), next to 恢复默认. Until it lands, the marker keeps its 保存 and reset. This comes in round 2, together with the wiring.
- **Field list.** ux-1 owns the shared field list `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/FieldList.tsx` (its PR 1, no behaviour change). This card keeps its local Fields level until that PR merges. Whichever of this card or ux-1's PR 2 lands second deletes the local copy and imports `FieldList` in the same PR. That replaces a separate card, per the maintainer's fold rule.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Claim amendment 2a (#35551 + #35553, area ux-3) · 2026-11-19T19:00Z
Correction to amendment 2: the `ObjectView.tsx` edit is ONE key on the existing `useObjectViewListRenderer({...})` call, `listViewActions: { rename, save, reset }` (rename: the personal rename on an owned view with the update grant, or the shared rename for an admin on a saved view; save: the reader's own view only; reset: the existing full reset). `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` forwards them to `<ListView>` as `onRenameView`, `onSaveView`, `onResetView`. Same two files, nothing else.
